periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Diagonal orientation slanting downward and inward toward the nasal bridge at approximately a 45-degree angle.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated irregular oval with a vertical-to-horizontal ratio greater than 1.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced downward tapering where the patch narrows significantly toward its lowest point relative to the upper bulbous region.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide lateral separation positioned at the superior-lateral margins of the cranium.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Smoothly rounded semicircular curvature at the superior boundary of both visible ears.
